source: sql/36_c12_constants.sql (contract_rep.c12_constants): the transfers between contracts (c12_events_cc), the latest allowances between contracts at t1 (c12_allow_triples, sql/36_c12_allow_triples.sql) and the transfers from user accounts to contracts (c12_user_events, sql/36_c12_user_events.sql) of the W0 score window
rule: b = ln 3 / m with m the median rounded to two significant digits (usd.round_sig); U is the 99th percentile of the US-dollar values of the transfers between contracts and U_user that of the transfers from user accounts to contracts, both of the W0 score window and rounded to two significant digits; m_A is the median of the positive usd_eff of the latest allowances between contracts at t1, unlimited ones included (docs/revision_contract_graph.md section 7)
